caption:
Cat Wu, the head of product for Claude Code, has left Anthropic.
She announced it on X and thanked the Claude Code team and its users. Anthropic confirmed the exit.
She is the second senior Claude Code departure in weeks, just before Anthropic's planned IPO.

paragraphs.text: Cat Wu, Anthropic's head of product for Claude Code, has left the company. She announced the move in a post on X on the afternoon of November 3, 2026, and Anthropic confirmed her departure to Business Insider. Unite.AI also reported the exit, citing her post.

Wu did not give a reason for leaving and did not say where she is headed, according to Business Insider, which said she did not respond to a request for comment. Unite.AI likewise reported no information about her next role.

Wu led product work on Claude Code, Anthropic's coding agent, and also oversaw Cowork, the company's tool for knowledge work outside of programming, Business Insider reported. Alongside Boris Cherny, the original creator of Claude Code, she was one of the two most visible leaders and promoters of the product.

She joined Anthropic in the summer of 2024. Unite.AI reported that she started in August 2024 as a product manager on the company's research product team. In her post, Wu recalled testing an early prototype of Claude Code that summer and becoming so taken with it that she joined the team, Business Insider reported.

Anthropic released Claude Code as a research preview in February 2025 with a demo video featuring Wu and Cherny. According to Business Insider, which cited The Information, the two briefly moved to Cursor that summer before returning to Anthropic a few weeks later. Wu also hired product managers and worked with the marketing, sales and finance teams.

In her farewell post, Wu thanked the teams behind Claude Code, Cowork and Tag and credited user feedback for shaping the product, according to Unite.AI, which said she described helping build Claude Code as the journey of a lifetime. When another user asked whether she planned to take six months off, she replied "post agi!", Business Insider reported.
A second senior exit before the IPO

Business Insider described Wu's departure as the second recent senior exit from the Claude Code product group. Thariq Shihipar, who also worked on Claude Code, announced last month that he was leaving the company.

The timing is notable because Anthropic is preparing for an initial public offering expected at the end of November, according to Business Insider. Claude Code drove fast growth for the company in late 2025, the outlet reported, lifting revenue and helping Anthropic fund more computing power as it competes with OpenAI.

In NeuraFeed's reading, the departure matters more for its visibility than for any immediate change to the product. Claude Code has become one of Anthropic's most important businesses, and Wu was one of the people most closely tied to it in public. Losing two senior members of that group within weeks, just ahead of a public listing, puts attention on who now leads the product and how Anthropic explains the changes to future shareholders.
The next thing to watch is whether Anthropic names a new head of product for Claude Code before its IPO, and where Wu goes next.
